_doc: Per-song special modes. match = regex (lowercase) on artist/title/album; all must match. colors = [primary, secondary] hex without #; without 'colors' they're taken from the album art. fixed_theme = use themes/<name>.json as is (don't regenerate). The first match wins. accents = 4 named colors (orange/purple/red/green) for a multicolor theme; colors = border/widgets. gradient: true = TV Girl's fixed shader; list of hex = left-to-right gradient with those colors (the first must be the theme's main accent). gradient also accepts {stops:[...], axis:'x'|'y', src: hex of the main accent to recolor}. cycle = list of colors: the main accent rotates in order with every lyric line (Streetcat). lyric_cycle = list of colors: only the active line of the Simple Lyrics widget rotates, one color per line. spectrum = left->right colors of Serpantinum's visualizer (cava). spectrum_bands = true: cava uses SOLID color bands (one per color) instead of blending. spectrum_wipe = true: cava is a single solid color and the next color sweeps over it from left to right, in order, looping. (Streetcat only uses 'spectrum': a fixed gradient with fade, no animation.)
